question: look at your list of tools that you can call. what types of questions can you answer?
final_answer:
Great question! Here's a breakdown of the types of questions I can answer, organized by capability:

---

## 📊 Market & Category Overview
- *"Which categories generate the most revenue?"*
- *"How many stores, items, and weeks of data exist for Beer?"*
- *"What's the date range of the dataset?"*

---

## 💰 Revenue & Profitability Analysis
- *"What are the top-selling categories by gross revenue?"*
- *"Which items drive the most revenue in Soft Drinks?"*
- *"How does net revenue (gross profit) compare across categories?"*
- *"Which stores are the highest performers?"*

---

## 📈 Trend & Time Series Analysis
- *"How has Beer revenue trended month-over-month?"*
- *"Are Frozen Dinner sales growing or declining over time?"*
- *"Show me weekly demand trends for a specific item."*

---

## 🏷️ Pricing & Price Distribution
- *"How much do prices vary within the Cheese category?"*
- *"What's the typical price range for Analgesics?"*
- *"Which categories have the most price volatility?"*

---

## 🧮 Price Elasticity Analysis
- *"Are Soft Drink buyers price-sensitive?"*
- *"Which items in Cookies are elastic vs. inelastic?"*
- *"What's the causal effect of a price change on demand for Cereals?"* (using DoWhy or DoubleML)
- *"Give me a rigorous elasticity estimate with a confidence interval for Laundry Detergents."*

---

## 🔮 Demand Forecasting
- *"Forecast the next 12 weeks of demand for this item."*
- *"What will sales look like next quarter if price stays the same?"*
- *"Forecast demand using price as a driver (ML model)."*

---

## 💡 What-If / Scenario Analysis
- *"What happens to revenue if I raise the price of this item by 10%?"*
- *"How much volume would I lose with a 5% price cut?"*
- *"Which price point maximizes revenue for this product?"*

---

## 📉 Visualizations
I can generate **bar charts, line charts, scatter plots, histograms, and time series plots** for any of the above analyses.

---

## 🔬 Causal Inference
- *"Is the price-demand relationship real, or driven by confounders like store or seasonality?"*
- *"Give me a causal elasticity estimate controlling for week and store effects."*

---

The dataset covers **~100 Dominick's grocery stores, 28 categories, and ~8 years (1989–1997)** of weekly scanner data — so I can go very deep on any of these! What would you like to explore? 🚀
